principle: An action may be selected for exploration only when its expected loss remains explicitly affordable and bounded by stop, pivot, scale, and rollback conditions.

loss_dimensions.time: bounded by one macro step or explicitly recorded extension
loss_dimensions.money: no new paid dependency, subscription, or commercial commitment without separate approval
loss_dimensions.ai_quota: bounded by targeted validation and evidence generation rather than unbounded exploration
loss_dimensions.reputation: avoid public claims beyond claim ceiling; keep Draft PR status until verified
loss_dimensions.maintenance_load: new objects must include validator coverage or a clear pending validation status
loss_dimensions.opportunity_cost: prefer actions that clarify next state over broad explanatory expansions
loss_dimensions.sleep_or_attention: do not require continuous human monitoring for routine CI waits

scale_requires: validator pass or explicit validation gap
